# std.metrics

<!-- Generated by `badger doc std` from the checked interfaces (badger 0.1.0). Do not edit by hand. -->

Metrics: counters, gauges, and histograms (OpenTelemetry's default
bucket bounds), aggregated in the runtime by name and attributes (a
`Codec` record, such as `{ route: "/orders", status: 200 }`). Recording
never fails; `snapshot` reads the cumulative values, and `std.otel`
exports them.

## Functions

### `add`

```badger
fn add<T>(name: String, value: Float, attrs: T) -> Unit where T: Codec
```

Add `value` to the counter `name`.

### `count`

```badger
fn count<T>(name: String, attrs: T) -> Unit where T: Codec
```

Add one to the counter `name`.

### `gauge`

```badger
fn gauge<T>(name: String, value: Float, attrs: T) -> Unit where T: Codec
```

Set the gauge `name` to `value`.

### `observe`

```badger
fn observe<T>(name: String, value: Float, attrs: T) -> Unit where T: Codec
```

Record `value` in the histogram `name`.

### `snapshot`

```badger
fn snapshot() -> List<Data>
```

Every metric's cumulative value: `name`, `kind` (`counter`, `gauge`,
`histogram`), `attributes`, and `value`, or for a histogram `count`,
`sum`, `min`, `max`, `bounds`, and `buckets`.
